correctness.rationale: Exact definitions and field hypotheses reconstructed. An integer 720-permutation expansion proves the seed determinant equals 35 times a degree-seven nonzero cyclotomic polynomial. Translation symmetry and invertible-Fourier Jacobi duality imply thirty zero minors. An exhaustive exact field-arithmetic C++17 certificate tests all 32767 nonempty masks for each of the two irreducible degree-four factors of Phi15 mod 7, verifies every multiplicative inverse and root order, and proves no additional singularities; all thirty nullities equal one. Both independent seed and full census programs replayed successfully from the actual staged paths. Finite enumeration is exhaustive for this finite claim.

value.rationale: The exact thirty-member singular-locus classification, split into one translation orbit and complementary orbit, including all primitive fifteenth roots and rank-one defects, is a natural finite-field Fourier invariant. It pinpoints all exceptions to the order-15 characteristic-7 input for the conditional lifting route toward the square-free order-105 principal-minor problem. This is complete structural information with a motivated prospective use, not a single cheap negative check. Does not purport to resolve complex order 105 or preclude alternate methods.
